column1: # Sound layer (PMD interface 048F, music API 04E4) - docs/re/sound.md

column3: if PMD resident (INT 60h vector+2 = "PMD"): query driver (pmd_query), state=0Bh, AH=01h stop; ret 1, else 0
(name far, vol%): stop if playing; open NAME.n / .s (PMD.COM only) / .m, part masks, fread into PMD buffer, AH=19h vol, AH=00h
if playing: INT 60h AH=05h measure counter + 1, else 0
1 if far ptr at 0000:0180 (INT 60h) points at xx xx 'P' 'M' 'D'
AH=06h music buffer, AH=22h buffer KB, AH=09h board type (FFh none), AH=17h PPS flag, PPSDRV probe
(kind 0 .m / 1 .s / 2 .n) PMD86/PMDB2 only (type 1,2): AH=1Eh AL=0Ah (mask K) or 88h (unmask I), then AH=1Eh AL=89h (unmask J)
(fp, 0L, len): no board -> 0; fseek 0; fread(PMD music buffer, len, 1, fp)
INT 64h vector+2 = "PMP" (PPSDRV): INT 64h AH=04h -> DS:DX PPS buffer, CX size (stored, never used)
(dst, name, ext): copy name up to '.', (SJIS-aware), append '.' ext
(name far, vol%) op 1B: if playing and name == g_mus_name: nothing; else stop, strncpy name (19), pmd_load_play
(t in 1/100 s) op 1C: blocking linear fade of g_mus_vol to 0 per VSYNC via AH=19h, then vol 0 and stop
op 35: -1 if no driver or not playing, else PMD measure counter + 1
s (tried on PMD.COM only; no .s files ship)
word, current volume % (op 1B operand; fade start value)
char[19], name of the playing song as given by the script ("none" initially)
far ptr (off 17A0, seg 17A2) from AH=06h = .M byte 0
word, AH=09h AL: 0 PMD.COM, 1 PMDB2, 2 PMD86, -1 no board
word, AH=17h AL==1 and PPSDRV resident (unused)
